index.title: The Nest
index.intro: The Nest is a multi-purpose platform designed for all STEAM communities and individuals. It aims to foster communication and stronger bonds among STEAM enthusiasts while providing open-access resources, educational curricula, and engineering guides.
index.founderText: Created by 7611#AmalHawks, The Nest Project aims to be an open repository empowering the entire FRC and STEM community. From rookie students to seasoned mentors, it simplifies access to essential engineering knowledge and inspires cross-team collaboration. Our mission is to expand the accessibility and sustainability of STEM education so every student can unlock their potential.
index.fyText: The Fikret Yüksel Foundation makes invaluable contributions to FIRST Robotics Competition (FRC), empowering young individuals in science, technology, engineering, and mathematics (STEM). The foundation provides material, logistical, and mentorship support to FRC teams, helping youth develop critical STEM capabilities and bring their creativity to life.
